source: Local/sliding-window attention can similarly skip tiles outside the permitted window. But once the model intentionally restricts which pairs are attended, the model’s attention pattern is sparse/local. ZXNAME0000XZ can be the kernel used to execute that pattern, but it is no longer the same mathematical problem as unrestricted dense attention.
zh: 本地/滑动窗口注意力同样可以跳过允许窗口之外的图块。但是，一旦模型有意限制关注哪些对，模型的注意力模式就会变得稀疏/局部。 ZXNAME0000XZ 可以是用于执行该模式的内核，但它不再是与无限制密集注意力相同的数学问题。
